high_level_description: The image depicts a piece of aged parchment with a list written on it. The background is dark and somewhat blurred, suggesting an indoor setting with dim lighting, possibly a library or a study room. The parchment has a slightly worn appearance, with visible creases and a small drawing of a bird in the bottom right corner. The text on the parchment reads: "Two live hens, their legs tied and heads hooded. Threescore candles of animal fat. Fresh well water from the town nearby, seventeen pints, cold, carried separately. Silver, ground to powder, mixed with chalk; enough to encircle a large room.
